claim: The FCLR-011 funding-conditioned volatility PASS (C2 vs B1, +4.94% relative QLIKE reduction, 95% CI [-0.032546,-0.001418], 5 instruments, 3 blocks, test 2026-05-08..2026-08-06) replicates out-of-sample on a pre-registered rolling-origin walk-forward over the most recent Binance mark-price cache (2026-08-07..2026-11-04), with >=2% relative QLIKE reduction, a 95% block-bootstrap CI excluding zero, >=5 instruments, >=3 non-overlapping 30-day test blocks, Holm across the declared 12-cell family, and no LOIO/placebo/leakage failure.

why_this_is_new.contradiction_being_resolved: The 2026-11-13 handoff and hypothesis_registry report every volatility campaign as NOT_MET and declare all claim-worthy local work exhausted. That is contradicted by research_state/evaluation_summary_FCLR-011.md (gate PASS) and evaluation_summary_FCLR-012-V.md (+15.19% point estimate). H1_primary.last_experiment is stale at FCLR-014, which predates FCLR-011. No artifact invalidates FCLR-011.
why_this_is_new.underpowered_prior_tests: FCLR-006 (2 blocks), FCLR-007 (0), FCLR-012-V (0), FCLR-013 (1), FCLR-014 (0) all failed the >=3-block gate because their test windows were 5-76 days. FCLR-009 (6 blocks) was NOT_MET; FCLR-011 (3 blocks) PASSED. The evidence is mixed and underpowered, not exhausted.
why_this_is_new.data_available_now: research_state/data_cache holds Binance 1h markPriceKlines for BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, BNBUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT for 2024-01-01..2026-11-08 (310 mark days in 2026 per symbol), with premiumIndexKlines and fundingRate for the same period. The 2026-08-07..2026-11-04 window supplies three contiguous 30-day blocks.
why_this_is_new.not_a_relitigation: No sealed FCLR-011/012-V/013/014 artifact is modified or re-scored. The FCLR-011 window is reproduced only as a pipeline-validation cell (REPRO-011) and is not counted as new confirmation evidence.
why_this_is_new.honesty: The test window overlaps prior fitting data (FCLR-012-V train/val) and two prior test windows (FCLR-013: 2026-08-26..2026-09-30; FCLR-012-V: 2026-10-29..2026-11-02). This is disclosed and a pre-registered sensitivity excluding those exact days is required. A CONFIRMED verdict must survive that sensitivity.

universe.selection_rule: fixed ex ante, identical to FCLR-011 for direct comparability

target.definition: sum of squared 1h log returns over t+1..t+24
target.missing_rule: origins without a complete 24h-ahead window are dropped; no imputation

features.abs_fund_pct: percentile rank of |funding| vs preceding 90 calendar days, min 30 observations, past-only

models.B1: HAR OLS on log RV1h, log RV24h, log RV168h
models.fit: OLS on log(target+1e-12), train-only standardization, training-only smearing back-transform; no regularization, no tuning

splits.design: rolling-origin walk-forward; each test block is out-of-sample for its own refit model; 7-calendar-day embargo between train end and test start; origins only
splits.pooled_test: union of the three test blocks (90 calendar days of origins, 5 instruments; 2026-10-28/29 mark days are genuinely absent from the archive and are dropped, not imputed)

inference.method: circular block bootstrap over UTC days, resampling days jointly across instruments

gates.placebo: true pooled rel reduction > 95th percentile of 200 funding-permutation refits
gates.sensitivity_excluding_inspected_days: pooled rel reduction >= 2% and CI excludes zero after removing 2026-08-26..2026-09-30 and 2026-10-29..2026-11-02
gates.repro_011: pipeline reproduces FCLR-011 rel reduction within +/-0.5 percentage points and CI excludes zero
gates.archive_gaps: 2026-10-28 and 2026-10-29 mark days are absent for all 5 symbols; origins on those days are dropped (no imputation). All three blocks retain >=28 observed days.

verdict_rules.CONFIRMED: all gates pass, including sensitivity and repro_011
verdict_rules.NOT_REPLICATED: materiality or CI fails on the full pooled test after a clean pipeline/repro check
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: pipeline/repro fails, or <3 blocks, or <5 instruments, or bootstrap infeasible

forbidden: no reuse of an inspected test window as fresh confirmation without the disclosed sensitivity
no zero-fill/forward-fill of missing features to force comparability
no mutation of sealed FCLR-011/012-V/013/014 artifacts
